info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_E-Branch Operations Status API
info.description: The E-Branch Operations Status API provides real-time information about the status of various e-branch operations within the banking channel. This API enables developers to seamlessly integrate and monitor the availability and performance of specific banking services. Typical consumers of this API include banking applications, customer service platforms, and operational dashboards that require up-to-date status reporting. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance user experience and ensure timely service delivery across their digital banking channels.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of e-branch operations.
get.description: This API endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of e-branch operations, providing essential information needed for effective management and tracking.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of e-branch operations specific to a channel. It should include all necessary parameters to identify the specific operation status being queried.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of e-branch operations.

GetEbranchOperationStatusRequest.description: This schema represents a request body for GET operations regarding the status of channel-specific branch operations.
